limits: Instrumentation is enabled for every arm; no traceless matched control exists, so overhead is not measured.
Host-observed readiness and stage timestamps are not GPU completion timestamps or independent kernel costs. Overlapping timers are not summed.
Forced continuation is not the raw greedy continuation. Raw target rows after a rejected position are censored; these labels do not measure free-generation model quality.
B-root correctness is conditional on A all-accept and a scoreable non-censored B. Multiplying marginal probabilities would not establish joint success.
Expert cache, PLE and elastic capacity persist across SSD restores. Their drift remains a confounder; no normalized or adjusted TPS is reported.
Warmup and 15-token smoke are functional diagnostics; the six long timings are instrumented diagnostics, not promotion of a performance lever.
No adaptive scheduling policy is implemented or evaluated by this record.
